tests: R31: the control plane refuses a malformed digest (required argument) and an instance with no evidence storage, and forwards the rest with its stamps

R31 (K649 (7)): the control plane's dispatch reaches op=pdfstructure (EXTRACTION_OPS) through extractionOp with its stamps, the store asked for only then; any other op answers null and asks for no store
R31 (N285, N347): an absent object is capture's one answer for it (its R63 evidenceAbsent): 404 EVIDENCE_NOT_HELD with its row, the store and the caller's class, and no byte read past the miss

R31: without ocr it is a read: EVIDENCE_NOT_HELD, FORMAT_UNREGISTERED, the entry's own answer for a non-PDF; otherwise the structure with tier 2, its tier and provenance; nothing written, and two reads answer alike
R32 R47: with ocr, before any byte is read or engine called: malformed flag, agent, no contribute, no OCR member, no reading the caller can see — each refused with its C-51 row

R33 R103: the press reads nothing and calls no engine: a reading with no page left owes nothing (performed false, written false, cost, why); one with pages left owes them, and a pass the member declines writes nothing and ends the job

R34 R24 (reading-pipeline R5, R11): with pages filled, the reading by reading-pipeline R11's rule with the stored type, at kept, page count and extent carried, provenance and reextracted; written by R19 with no bundle version; the answer reports the listeners and the index
R34 R24: a re-read whose write a listener refuses is rolled back whole and says so, never as the capture having left the caller's sight; the same re-read with the listener quiet is written (control)

R35 R103 G132k (reading-pipeline R7): each pass asks only for the pages the stored reading still leaves unread, so repeated passes reach a long scan's tail; the pass loads no object and parses nothing
R33 R34 (reading-pipeline R8): through the pass, a page whose stored text tier 2 decoded keeps it, unasked; a page OCR fills is read and indexed

R52: an agenda item's membership in a file is derived from containment under the link shapes the active profiles state, labelled machine work graded C, beside links[] and never inside them; none stated, null with the reason

R34 (reading-pipeline R12, R17; N100, N139; fix round 9, G128c: the boxes are the stored rows'): the pass carries the stored reading's page boxes, else none; and its own text counts by the acquire path's rule
R31 (N100): the plain read carries pdf-reader's own pageBoxes beside membership and membershipWhy, and writes nothing

R34 (reading-pipeline R28; K1557): a re-read's reading carries what the pdf entry emitted beside the text, as the stored reading holds it: its metadata, or null when it emitted none, and no workbook cells
